description: A Perl script for generating package metadata, configuration, and dependency information in various formats, including JSON and makefile syntax. It includes functions for version comparison, dependency resolution, and generating CycloneDX SBOMs.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string to a numeric value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on a comparison with a specified version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates kernel config overrides based on package info and build system config.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a specific package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion when checking package dependencies.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relationship between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration lines for menuconfig.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict configuration lines for menuconfig.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Prints a menuconfig category with its packages.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Prints package override configuration if any.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates package configuration in menuconfig format.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition into a menuconfig expression.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a complex condition into a menuconfig expression.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps a dependency string with conditionals.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates package makefile dependencies and build rules.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs package source file information.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary package variables.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs package license information.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Outputs a filtered list of version strings.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignment lists.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from a file.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata from a file.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Parses package manifest JSON data.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads image manifest and returns package list.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Creates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON structure from components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for image packages.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates CycloneDX SBOM for package manifests.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and executes corresponding functions.
